name: Pixel backdrop
summary: Pixel-art background generator: blocky sky, far hills, mountains, city or sea, tiled ground; tile kit for pixel scenes.

params.name: time
params.note: sky colours; night and space add twinkling stars, day a sun, night a moon

params.name: far
params.note: pixel silhouette standing on the ground line

params.name: ground
params.note: tiled ground from groundY down (water and lava animate)

params.name: groundY
params.note: y of the ground line; stand characters on it

params.name: anim
params.note: drift = clouds move from p.f; water, lava and stars always animate

author: krakujs
